name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Retention & Success Leader | B2B SaaS
summary: Customer success and retention leader with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, focused on keeping SMB and mid-market customers through the moments that decide whether they stay. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (~94%) by catching adoption gaps early and turning partner feedback into product input. Led a team of up to 20 onboarding specialists at Wix for two years, hiring, training, and coaching to 110% of implementation targets. Builds AI-driven automation and clean CRM structures so a team spends its time on customers instead of admin, with hands-on Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zendesk experience.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary relationship for a portfolio of service-business clients, from discovery and onboarding through retention and scope expansion.
Built automated SMS and email recovery and reactivation workflows (no-show recovery, long-term reactivation, review requests) within a 20+ workflow GoHighLevel system.
Design LLM-based agent workflows and automation in Zapier, Make, and n8n that remove manual admin, and evaluate AI output against rubric-based standards.
Architect CRM structures in GoHighLevel and HubSpot with lifecycle stages, user permissions, and strict data-hygiene rules, and document every client interaction and deliverable.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent across implementations to protect satisfaction and retention on multi-stakeholder accounts.
Coordinated execution across internal departments and delivered QBRs that turned performance data into recommendations.

experience.title: Partner Success & Retention (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps early, recommending interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows so they could keep their own customers.
Turned recurring partner friction into structured, prioritized feedback for Product and Engineering, and tracked the book in Salesforce.
Built automated training sequences and communication workflows that reduced onboarding friction across the network.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team while running client accounts end to end, and built processes that reduced handoff errors and improved cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new team members and developed sales training for tenured account executives, helping take a new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Launched 25+ clients per month personally while holding 110% of implementation and 120% of sales targets.
Defined CRM fields for sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Escalated account risk to leadership early and mitigated it with direct strategic guidance, advising C-suite clients on operational system design.
Troubleshot workflow and technical issues during setup alongside implementation teams, tracking customer issues in Zendesk.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
